text:
olivia: Quick preflight — our 'Inference at Scale' webinar is Wed 4/10 9:00am PT (that's 1:00am AEST). Need a short checklist: reg page copy, Zoom settings, recorder, and lead routing. Who can own each?
maria: I can take reg page + confirmation email. Will reuse last webinar template but update CTAs and the benchmark stat.
raj: I'll own Zoom setup and recording. Plan: cloud recording to local backup + automatic SRT captions. Need to confirm 'record automatically' and 'enable cloud recording' flags.
sam: I can map lead routing — SFDC campaign + Marketo list. Quick question: do we gate the slide deck behind the form or send via nurture?
olivia: Gate the slides for the first 48 hours to capture leads, then send nurture with highlights. Also want an immediate thank-you email with replay placeholder.
maria: For confirmation copy, suggest: "Thanks — you're registered for Inference at Scale. We'll send a calendar invite + reminder 1 day before." Keep it short. Anyone have subject line ideas?
sam: Subject: "You're in — Inference at Scale (Apr 10)" or shorter: "Confirmed: Inference at Scale". I prefer the shorter one.
raj: Zoom checklist: 1) Host account assigned (done), 2) Co-hosts set (olivia + raj), 3) Record to cloud + local backup (enabled), 4) Auto captions on (SRT), 5) Participants muted on entry, 6) Waiting room off (we'll manage via panelists). 7) Alternative RTMP fallback configured.
zoom-bot: deploy: cloud-recording enabled for meeting id 987-654-321; recording retention set to 30 days.
maria: Email flows: Confirmation (instant), Reminder (1 day prior), Reminder (1 hour prior), Replay with slides (48 hours post), Nurture (7 days). Need owners for the 48h replay editing + clips.
nish: I'll take ownership of clip edits and the short highlight reel for social. Need source SRT and timestamps.
olivia: Good. For the registration page, CTA should be "Reserve your spot". We must include a short opt-in for follow-ups + checkbox for clips.
maria: Also add a hidden utm param for campaign=benchmark-launch and source=email. I'll set up landing page form field mapping to Marketo: email, company, role, opt-in boolean, utm_campaign.
sam: Lead routing: MQL criteria = title contains "engineer" OR company size > 50 OR job level >= manager. Route to SDR queue if MQL, otherwise nurture list. I'll drop the exact Marketo smart list after this thread.
raj: Ops note — plan for 2 redundant recorders: cloud + local OBS on producer laptop. OBS will run at 1080p30 for archive. Please make sure presenter laptops have wired ethernet.
olivia: Presenters: ask them to disable notifications and join 15m early. We'll run a 10m mic check + slides pass.
maria: I'll draft the confirmation and reminder copy now and post links. Expect a slot by EOD.
nish: For clips, prefer 3x 60-90s snippets: headline stat, demo clip, closing CTA. I'll coordinate timestamps with raj during upload.
sam: Once reg page is live, share the link here and I’ll start paid promo + cohort targeting.
olivia: Timeline: reg page live by Fri EOD, emails scheduled Mon, rehearsal Tue, live Wed. If anyone hits a blocker, ping here or DM. :thumbsup:
maria: Done — I'll post the draft link in ~2 hours.
raj: I'll submit the Zoom settings and invite links once I enable co-hosts.
nish: I'll prep a folder in Drive for raw recordings + assets. Will share link in thread when ready.
zoom-bot: reminder: automatic captions require host to enable live transcript during meeting.
olivia: Thanks all — this helps. Quick to-dos: maria (reg & emails), raj (Zoom + recording), sam (lead routing & promos), nish (clip edits). We'll reconvene Tue after rehearsal. :rocket:
